{{Event Infobox
| Name  = The Mausoleum
| Image = Event-Mausoleum.png
}} {{Small Card Infobox|Writhe}}
{{E|The Mausoleum}} is an [[Event]] found in [[Act 2]]. It is one of the events affected by {{Asc|15|Ascension}}.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Open Coffin}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a [[Relic]].}} {{TS|negative||50% {{Asc|15|(100%)}}: Become Cursed - {{C|Writhe}}}}

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens. 

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Venturing through a series of tombs, you are faced with a large sarcophagus {{TS||up|studded with gems}} in the center of a circular room. <br>
You cannot make out the writing on the coffin, however, you do notice {{TS|purple|up|black fog}} seeping out from the sides.
</div><br><br>

{{Frame|Open Coffin}}

The dialogue changes depending on whether the player becomes cursed with {{C|Writhe}} or not.

'''If the player does not receive {{C|Writhe}}:'''

<blockquote>
<div style="font-style:italic">
You push open the coffin. The fog dissipates harmlessly. Inside, you find the mortal remains of a decorated soldier grasping an old {{TS|gold||relic.}} You pilfer it and move on.
</div>
</blockquote>

'''If the player receives {{C|Writhe}}:'''

<blockquote>
<div style="font-style:italic">
You push open the coffin. As you do, {{TS|purple|up|black fog}} spews forth and covers the entire room! Inside, you find no body, only a {{TS|gold|up|relic.}} You take it and move onwards, {{TS|negative|shake|coughing violently.}}
</div>
</blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You continue on your way, leaving the forgotten dead undisturbed.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Notes ==
<!-- I originally didn't trust this information from the Fandom wiki, but I confirmed it was correct using Basemod to repeatedly enter the event and claim the relic until it yielded Matryoshka and Darkstone Periapt -->
* If the player receives {{R|Omamori}} as the [[Relic]] reward, it '''will not''' prevent the {{C|Writhe}} from being gained.
* If the player receives {{R|Darkstone Periapt}} as the [[Relic]] reward, it '''will''' grant the +6 Max HP.

== Trivia ==
* A [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mausoleum mausoleum] is a building that encloses and protects the burial chamber of one or more deceased. The term "mausoleum" comes from the burial chamber of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mausolus King Mausolus] as enclosed by the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mausoleum_at_Halicarnassus Mausoleum at Halicarnassus].
